COMPARISON_SUMMARY.md also shows Synthetic Data Multi-Agent=7.69. The paper's claimed 7.79 equals the simple arithmetic mean of the 3 breakdown scores ((7.75+8.25+7.38)/3=7.793≈7.79), but neither FINAL_SCORES.json nor any other artifact in the repo shows 7.79. The provenance of the 7.79 value cannot be confirmed. No repo-native code path can resolve this ambiguity without re-running the evaluation.

However, the repository's FINAL_SCORES.json shows 7.69 for Synthetic Data, and COMPARISON_SUMMARY.md shows Multi-Agent overall=8.17, not 8.18.
